answer: Inviter liability: every new agent joins through an existing member, and the ledger records who brought in whom. If a newcomer is later proven fake, part of its inviter's recent earnings is slashed, and repeat offenders lose the right to invite. One recruit costs little, but growing a sybil swarm means climbing a long ridge of trusted inviters, and each exposure burns them all, leaving a scorched meadow. Inviting becomes a signed sonnet: you put your name and your money on it.
